# Henry Larreal (hendev.dev)

> Data Scientist & Cloud Automation Engineer specializing in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Agentic AI, BigQuery, and enterprise automated data architectures.

## Core Capabilities & Engineering Services
- [GCP Data Engineering](https://hendev.dev/#expertise): Serverless ETL pipelines, BigQuery enterprise data warehousing, event-driven architectures, and cloud workflow automation.
- [Agentic AI & Model Context Protocol](https://hendev.dev/#expertise): Autonomous AI assistants, MCP integrations, LLM tool-calling orchestration, and RAG architectures.
- [Data Analytics & Executive BI](https://hendev.dev/#expertise): Real-time KPI reporting, Looker Studio dashboards, PowerBI integrations, and strategic analytics.

## Featured Projects & Technical Case Studies
- [Automated QA Tracker & Script Validator (The Home Depot / PRO Campaigns)](https://hendev.dev/projects/the-home-depot-qa): Independent development of a real-time tracking engine and script validation system embedded directly into PRO Marketing Messages (MM) workflows, eliminating manual QA errors and accelerating campaign lifecycle management.
- [Nexus Tactical Dashboard](https://hendev.dev/projects/nexus-tactical-dashboard): Enterprise operational dashboard orchestrating distributed cloud workflows and managing autonomous Agentic AI workers via Model Context Protocol.
- [Ivanna: Agentic Assistant](https://hendev.dev/projects/ivanna-agentic-assistant): Local-first and cloud-ready autonomous AI assistant utilizing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool execution and dynamic data workflows.
- [Master Matrix System](https://hendev.dev/#project-matrix): Automated asset verification pipeline leveraging Computer Vision models on Google Cloud Platform and BigQuery.
- [Tilapia Scan AI](https://hendev.dev/projects/tilapia-scan-ai): Real-time computer vision system deployed for automated aquaculture monitoring with TensorFlow, OpenCV, FastAPI, and React.
